rounding: signed rational round-half-even; clamp after update
rating_update: r_next = clamp(r + RHE(125000000 * (observed - expected) / Q), 0, Q)
avf_history_prior: p_next = clamp(p + RHE(62500000 * ((2 * observed - Q) - p) / Q), -Q, Q)
ranking: score = clamp(base + RHE(250000000 * prior / Q), 0, Q); units = RHE(score * 1000000 / Q)
half_life: H = clamp(RHE(86400 * (Q/2 + r_next) * regret_factor * freshness_factor * safety_factor / Q^4), 3600, 604800)
factors: Unknown regret: Q/2; known regret: Q - regret_norm. Freshness factor: Q. Verified unsafe: safety Q/2; otherwise Q.
decay: trust(age) = RHE(rating * 2^(-age/H)); exact rational branch for integral half-lives; Decimal precision 80 otherwise; zero at age >= 64H. Time admission is separate.
review: pressure = Q - trust; review recommended below 600000000; unusable time yields full advisory pressure, not authority.
limits: 256 deliveries; 64 effective occurrences; duplicates audited without extra updates; sample state WARM at 3, otherwise SPARSE/COLD. Missing expectation or unsupported profile remains NO_UPDATE.
authority: Advisory ranking only. No permission, hard veto, model weight update, or calibrated market probability.
